calls.name: iProperties.ValueInComponent
calls.evidence: The Inventor 2014 help lists iProperties.ValueInComponent under deprecated functions, says it is no longer in the Snippets area but still works in a rule, and says iProperties.Value is preferred.
calls.sourceQuote: the iProperties.Value function is preferred instead of these older functions.
calls.note: The only documentation found is from the 2014 help and nothing covers 2027.2, but it marks the call deprecated while still functional.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference iProperties.ValueInComponent

calls.name: MessageBox.Show
calls.evidence: The Message Box Functions Reference documents MessageBox.Show as the base function for showing message boxes in iLogic rules, with syntax and button, icon and default-button options, and does not mark it deprecated or removed.
calls.sourceQuote: Acts as the base for the Message Box functions in iLogic. Use this function to show a message box.
calls.note: The available pages are for the 2022 and 2024 releases, not 2027.2, but they describe the call as available and show no deprecation.
